title: Optimal bound for the polynomial Littlewood-Offord problem
summary: We present an exposition of an argument, discovered by GPT-6 Pro, that gives an optimal bound for the polynomial Littlewood-Offord problem. Namely, let $F$ be a degree-$d$ multilinear polynomial that contains $r$ degree-$d$ monomials involving disjoint sets of variables. Then, for i.i.d. Rademacher random variables $ξ_1, \ldots, ξ_n$, we have $\mathbb{P}[F(ξ_1, \ldots, ξ_n) = 0] = O_d(r^{-1/2})$. This improves upon the previous bound of $(\log r)^{O_d(1)} r^{-1/2}$ due to Meka, O.
